_nota: Textos de interfaz en inglés. Traducción de Claude (28-11-2026). Mireia no revisa el inglés: lo deja en manos de Claude (28-11-2026).

hero.intro: Many of history's great women remained hidden for fear of reprisals. On this website we will shine a light into the darkness. Move the mouse or drag your finger to discover the hidden names.

mujeres.pista: Tap a card to flip it and see the real photo, or press “View profile” to open it right here.

juego.parrafo1: Besides all the activities on this website, you can also download FEMINIST, the video game, on your phone.
juego.parrafo2: It's fun, it takes a stand and it's feminist, of course. In it you'll face the patriarchy, overcome obstacles loaded with inequality and reflect on our struggle.
juego.parrafo3: But don't worry: when you run out of strength, the great women of history will give you their energy and wisdom. Visit them, discover their stories (scientists, artists and leaders who changed the world) and get back on the path stronger.

actividades.intro: Every activity you complete earns you a stamp, which is saved in your browser.

glosario.intro: Words worth knowing, explained by professionals. Tap one to see what it means.

informatica.titulo: Made by a woman in computing
informatica.parrafo1: This website and this game were created by a woman, in a field where men are a clear majority. Mireia worked for years as a teacher before switching to programming. When choosing what to study, she never considered this option — nor did her friends. Why do you think it never even crossed her mind?
informatica.parrafo2: And you, have you ever thought about studying computer science?
